_about: Unique characters: named people who exist once. Never rolled as an ordinary newcomer. A rumor's effects bring one to the village (unique_arrives:<id>) or lose them for good (unique_lost:<id>). See scripts/uniques.gd.

uniques.name: Miyu
uniques.about: The village elder's granddaughter. She was away in the next village when the mist came down.

loved: Oh! For me? I love these. Thank you, {miko}!
You remembered! I'll make it last. ...No I won't.
liked: That's kind of you. Thank you.
plain: Um. Thank you? I'll find a use for it.
disliked: Oh. ...Thank you. I'll, um, put it somewhere.
Is this a joke? ...Sorry. Thank you.
already: You've already given me something today. Keep it for yourself!

says: {miko}! I was hoping you'd come by.
There you are. How's your day been?
I saved you a spot. Tell me everything.

topics.says: Grandfather fusses, but he hasn't let me out of his sight since I got back. I keep thinking about the others in that village. I should have been able to do something.

replies.text: You stayed alive. That was the something.
replies.answer: ...I hadn't thought of it like that. Thank you, {miko}.

replies.text: There was nothing you could have done.
replies.answer: I suppose not. It doesn't feel that way, though.

replies.text: Best not to dwell on it.

topics.ask: You keep looking at my ears.
topics.says: I'm sorry! It's rude, I know. It's only that I've never met anyone like you. Some of the others whisper about it. Does it bother you?

replies.text: A little. But not from you.
replies.answer: Then I'll look as much as I like. ...That came out wrong.

topics.ask: What did you see, in the mist?
topics.says: It came from the north, slowly, like weather. Then it wasn't slow at all. The things in it don't just wander, {miko}. Something sends them. I'm sure of it.

replies.text: Then we'll find what sends them.
replies.answer: We? ...I'd like that. I don't want to only hide.
For now. Thank you for saying it.

topics.says: Every time! The way the charm lights before the fire comes. I've tried to copy the gestures when nobody's looking. Nothing happens, of course. Is it something you're born with?

replies.text: Some of it. Most of it is learned.
replies.answer: Learned. So someone could teach it. Or a book could. ...I'm only thinking out loud.

topics.ask: Will you stay in the village?
topics.says: I used to think I'd leave as soon as I was grown. Now I can't think where I'd rather be. That's your fault, you know.

replies.answer: The village. Yes. That's what I meant, too.

milestones.says: Miyu has started saving you a seat by the fire.
Miyu trusts you: she'll talk about the mist now.
Miyu looks for you first when she comes in from work.
Miyu has something she wants to ask you.

uniques.name: Genzo
uniques.about: The village's elder, Miyu's grandfather. Gives the rumor to find her, and later the village into Sera's keeping.
